body: Commits a99eff4/2badb4f on main. Closes the cursor-indicator half of the old S170-69 northstar item -- SDL_CreateSystemCursor/SDL_SetCursor swaps to a crosshair over a live hittable enemy hero, default arrow otherwise. The color-coded YOU/ALLY/ENEMY bracket+label half was already shipped earlier this session. Client-only, full suite green. The other half of S170-69 (a real draft/lobby pick-a-hero UI, replacing auto-draft) is substantial standalone work, split into its own backlog item and left open.
title: Real cursor-shape swap on enemy hover (S170-69)
